'''Avenelle''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian sector]]. It was a luxurious world known as a place to rest while traveling along the [[Lesser Lantillian Route/Legends|Lesser Lantillian Route]] or for retirement.<ref name="TEA" />
